---
title: "Basemap gallery"
---

Every basemap in the catalogue that needs no API key, rendered for the same
view of the San Francisco Bay Area (the Utah basemaps [below](#utah), over
Salt Lake City). The names work as a style anywhere: in `basemap()`,
`style()`, plots, and in R and Rust.

```{python}
import basemapper as bm

providers = bm.list_providers()
keyless = [p for p in providers if p["api_key_env"] is None]
utah = [p for p in keyless if p["name"].startswith("UGRC.")]
world = [p for p in keyless if p not in utah]
print(len(world), "basemaps")

images = {}
for p in world:
    m = bm.basemap(p["name"], center=(-122.25, 37.75), zoom=9, width=340, height=220)
    images[p["name"]] = m.render().to_png()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
# Lay out rendered images, with each one's name and form.
import base64
from IPython.display import HTML


def gallery(entries):
    cells = []
    for p in entries:
        src = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(images[p["name"]]).decode()
        form = "vector" if p["vector"] else "raster"
        cells.append(f'<figure class="bm-cell"><img src="{src}" alt="{p["name"]}" loading="lazy">'
                     f'<figcaption><code>{p["name"]}</code> <span>{form}</span></figcaption></figure>')
    return HTML('<div class="bm-gallery">' + "\n".join(cells) + "</div>")


gallery(world)
```

The vector basemaps (OpenFreeMap, and Esri's vector styles) are drawn from
vector tiles by basemapper's port of MapLibre GL JS; the raster ones are
tile images. Esri's names have both forms; `style(provider(name,
form="raster"))` picks the other one.

## Utah {#utah}

The Utah Geospatial Resource Center's vector basemaps cover Utah. Each is
published as separate services (a hillshade, a base map and labels, or
imagery and an overlay), and its name stands for the whole stack: one
style, whose filters (`style("UGRC.Lite", features="-labels")`) treat its
services as one map.

```{python}
print([p["name"] for p in utah])
for p in utah:
    m = bm.basemap(p["name"], center=(-111.89, 40.70), zoom=10, width=340, height=220)
    images[p["name"]] = m.render().to_png()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
gallery(utah)
```

## With an API key

CARTO, Stadia Maps and MapTiler need a free API key, and UGRC Discover's
raster basemaps of Utah (terrain, topographic, hillshade and imagery,
with UGRC's road and label overlay as their labels) its quad word. Each is
read from the environment variable in `api_key_env`, or given to the style:
`style("MapTiler.Streets", key="...")`.

```{python}
for p in providers:
    if p["api_key_env"]:
        print(f"{p['name']:<26} {p['api_key_env']}")
```
